title: 2.5.25 Predict, Then Run: try/catch/finally Together
description: Predict the output of a try/catch/finally with a throw inside it, then build it and check. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Predict first
steps.instructions: Before writing anything, predict the output of this sequence: log "A", throw new Error("boom"), catch logs "B: " + err.message, finally logs "C", then after the whole statement, log "D".

steps.title: Build it
steps.instructions: Write a try block that logs "A", then throws new Error("boom"). In the catch block, log "B: " + err.message. In the finally block, log "C". After the whole try...catch...finally, log "D".

steps.title: Check your prediction
steps.instructions: Run it and compare the actual output to your prediction line by line.

requirements.title: try/catch/finally present
requirements.description: Code has a try, catch, and finally block

requirements.title: D logged after the whole statement
requirements.description: "D" is logged after the finally block closes
